trap.label: according to me
trap.wrong: According to me, the plan is sensible.
trap.right: In my opinion, the plan is sensible.
trap.why: Em português "segundo eu" é calco. Em inglês, according to é para fontes; para opinião própria use in my opinion.

fix.wrong: The result depends of the sample.
fix.right: The result depends on the sample.

fix.wrong: In my point of view, it is fair.
fix.right: In my view, it is fair.

fix.wrong: There is an increase of cars.
fix.right: There is an increase in cars.
